column1: # r11 (ATM-1217 review F5): the expected sha256 of the units helper binary, per source hash (sha256 over units_helper/
# except this file, as _units_source_hash computes it) and go toolchain. The build is reproducible (-trimpath,
# -buildvcs=false, CGO_ENABLED=0, -mod=vendor; measured: two builds from empty GOCACHE dirs give the same bytes).
# On a listed (reference) toolchain a cached or freshly built binary with any other sha256 is refused, and r12
# (review G3) a source hash with NO row is refused too (re-pin with review/lib/units_pin_refresh.py --write, which
# builds twice and refuses a non-reproducible build); an unlisted toolchain is accepted on the recomputed stamp only
# (stated limit). An absent, unreadable or malformed table is refused. Columns: source-hash go-version goos/goarch binary-sha256
